landingItems.question: What is HeyMaa?
landingItems.answer: HeyMaa is your helper through motherhood — one app for support, organization, and memories. It does not replace a doctor or pharmacist.

sections.title: What you can do
bullets: Chat with an AI helper — write, speak, or send a photo
Development milestones by age with a progress timeline

sections.title: How you talk to HeyMaa
bullets: Write what's on your mind — HeyMaa replies using recent chat, saved memories, and ticked milestones (depending on your plan)
Use the microphone — speech-to-text (does not use your Listen quota)
Tap Listen for a spoken reply — counts toward your monthly voice quota
Send a photo when you need more context

sections.title: Who it's for
sections.intro: From pregnancy and the first year through later childhood. 17 languages supported — the app adapts to the language you choose.

landingItems.question: What does the free trial include?
landingItems.answer: 14 days of full access to try HeyMaa. No credit card required to start.

sections.title: Included
bullets: Up to 50 voice playbacks (Listen) per month
Daily memory: 20 recent messages + 10 saved memories + 10 ticked milestones in each reply
Family tree, milestones, memory notes & photos

sections.title: Starts from Starter
bullets: Full document/album management (upload & edit), without the ability to download or share files
Basic memory and more archived conversations

sections.title: After the trial
sections.intro: If you don't upgrade, access stops at the end of 14 days. You'll get a reminder before expiry.

landingItems.question: What's the difference between plans?
landingItems.answer: All plans include unlimited chat. They differ in voice, chat memory, documents/album, archiving, and support.

sections.title: Free trial (14 days)
bullets: No card required to sign up

sections.title: Starter — €19/month
bullets: Document Archive & Album, without the ability to download or share files

sections.title: Reading the plans
bullets: Tap (i) next to lines that have it, for a short explanation
When a feature needs a higher plan, you'll see an Upgrade message
Change plan anytime in Settings → Subscription

landingItems.question: What happens when the trial ends?
landingItems.answer: If you don't choose a subscription plan, app access stops at the end of 14 days.

sections.title: What you'll see
bullets: A reminder before the trial expires
Your data stays stored — it is not deleted automatically

sections.title: How to continue
bullets: Or from the upgrade prompt when opening the app

landingItems.question: Does HeyMaa give medical advice?
landingItems.answer: No. HeyMaa does not replace a doctor, midwife, pediatrician, or pharmacist.

sections.title: What HeyMaa does
bullets: General information about motherhood, development, and daily life
Reminds you to consult a professional for health matters
Helps organize documents and milestones — not diagnose

sections.title: When to call a doctor
sections.intro: For any symptom, fever, allergic reaction, development concern, or change in your child's behavior — contact a healthcare professional immediately.

landingItems.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
landingItems.answer: Cancel inside the app — no email or phone request needed.

sections.title: Steps
bullets: Confirm — you keep access until the end of the period you already paid for

sections.title: Important
bullets: You can restore the subscription until the period ends
Your data is not deleted when you cancel

landingItems.question: Is my data safe?
landingItems.answer: Yes — your data belongs to you. You control export and deletion from the app.

sections.title: What you can do
bullets: Export a copy (JSON) from Settings → Privacy & data
Read the Privacy Policy from the footer or Settings

sections.title: What is stored
sections.intro: Chat, memories, family tree, milestones, documents, and preferences — linked to your account, not public.

items.question: What is HeyMaa?
items.answer: HeyMaa is your helper through motherhood — one app for support, organization, and memories.

sections.title: Important
sections.intro: Does not replace a doctor or pharmacist. For health matters, always consult a professional.

items.question: What can I do in the app?
items.answer: The app is organized in tabs. Depending on your plan, some features may require an upgrade.

sections.title: Chat
bullets: Listen to replies with the Listen button (monthly quota)
HeyMaa uses recent chat + saved memories + ticked milestones (memory level per plan)

sections.title: Memories
bullets: Notes, photos, and videos (videos from Starter+)
Auto-add from milestones when you tick them

sections.title: Family
bullets: Visual family tree — edit & rearrange by drag
Document archive: tests, vaccines, treatments, medicines
Badge with memory count per member

sections.title: Milestones
bullets: Tick only what has already happened

items.question: What does the free trial include?
items.answer: 14 days to try everything. No credit card required.

sections.title: Included
bullets: Family tree, milestones, memory notes & photos

sections.title: Not in trial
bullets: Basic/Full memory — Daily only on trial

items.question: What happens when the trial ends?
items.answer: Without an upgrade, access stops at the end of 14 days.

sections.title: After expiry
bullets: Main content won't open without an active plan
Your data is not deleted automatically

items.question: How do voice messages work?
items.answer: The monthly limit applies to voice playbacks of HeyMaa's replies — the Listen button.

sections.title: How Listen works
bullets: Your remaining quota appears above the chat
When used up, you'll see an upgrade prompt

sections.title: What doesn't count
sections.intro: Speaking in chat (microphone → text) does not use your monthly Listen quota. Only playback of HeyMaa's reply counts.

items.question: What's the difference between plans?
items.answer: All plans include unlimited chat. Everything else varies by plan.

sections.title: Starter (€19/month)
bullets: Document Archive & Album, without the ability to download or share files, memory videos

sections.title: Tip
sections.intro: Tap (i) next to lines that have it. When a higher plan is needed, you'll see Upgrade.

items.question: What is Daily, Basic, and Full memory?
items.answer: Three levels of chat memory — how many recent messages, saved memories, and ticked milestones HeyMaa uses in each reply.

sections.title: What the numbers mean
bullets: First number: recent chat messages in context
Second number: saved memories it can recall
Higher plans = richer context for better answers

sections.title: Related features
bullets: Photos, albums, documents: from trial (view-only); Starter without the ability to download or share files; download Premium+
Memory is not unlimited history — it's a smart window for better replies

items.question: How do milestones work?
items.answer: Development milestones are organized in age periods with a visual progress timeline. Ticked milestones also feed chat replies — alongside messages and memories, according to your plan.

sections.title: What you can do
bullets: Tick only milestones that have already happened
Future ones show as preview — can't tick yet

sections.title: Chat, memories & points
bullets: Ticked milestones feed chat replies (the third memory number)
Ticking may auto-add to your memory journal

items.question: What is the Document Archive?
items.answer: On the Family tab you keep medical and admin documents organized.

sections.title: By plan
bullets: Starter: full upload & edit, without the ability to download or share files

items.question: What is the family tree?
items.answer: A visual map of your family on the Family tab.

sections.title: Linked to memories
sections.intro: Each member's memory count appears as a badge on their card.

items.question: Does HeyMaa give medical advice?
items.answer: No — HeyMaa does not replace a healthcare professional.

sections.title: What it offers
sections.intro: General information, organization, and emotional support — not diagnosis or treatment.

sections.title: What to do
sections.intro: For any health concern — yours or your child's — consult a doctor, pediatrician, or pharmacist.

sections.title: Available languages
bullets: Greek, English, Italian, German, French, Spanish
Arabic, Turkish, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese, Dutch

sections.title: How to change language
sections.intro: Settings → Language. Applies to chat, screens, and notifications.

items.question: How do I upgrade my subscription?
items.answer: When you need a higher-plan feature, the app guides you.

sections.title: From an Upgrade prompt
bullets: Appears when you tap a feature your plan doesn't cover

items.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.answer: Inside the app — Settings → Subscription → Cancel subscription.

sections.title: After cancelling
bullets: Access until the end of the paid period

items.question: I forgot my password
items.answer: Reset via email — no need to call support.

sections.title: Steps
bullets: On the sign-in screen, tap Forgot password?
Open the link you receive and set a new password

sections.title: Didn't get the email?
sections.intro: Check spam/promotions. If it persists, email info@heymaa.ai.

items.question: Do I need an invite code?
items.answer: Usually not — sign up with email and password.

sections.title: Without a code
sections.intro: Create an account normally. You start a 14-day trial.

sections.title: With an invite code
bullets: Enter it at registration if you were given one
Earn +40 points when a friend signs up with your code

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Your data belongs to you — you control export and deletion.

sections.title: What is stored
sections.intro: Chat, memories, family, milestones, documents — linked to your account, not public.
